description.value: Thai New West is an intimate, family-owned Thai restaurant in the Sapperton neighbourhood of New Westminster, open since 2012 and founded by chefs with credentials from Johnson & Wales University and storied hotel kitchens including the Four Seasons and Capital Hilton. The menu celebrates Central Thai cuisine from Bangkok, with generous family-style portions spanning fiery stir-fries, aromatic coconut curries, and dedicated vegetarian and gluten-free sections. A curated wine list from small BC producers and classic Singha beer round out the experience.
